name: bambu-p2s-maintanence-tracker
description: Mobile-first maintenance tracker foundation for a Bambu Lab P2S.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "npm run dev --workspace backend"

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace backend
